channel.title: MONAD SYSTEMS Posts
channel.description: Engineering insights on architecture, API design-first delivery, and backend platform development.

item.title: A Monorepo for Your Laptop: Git Submodules as a Development Workspace
item.description: A monorepo makes cross-package work easy and couples everything else. Separate repositories keep packages independent and make local development painful. A thin workspace built from git submodules gives developers the linked, single-checkout experience while every package and app stays a complete repository that builds, tests, releases, and deploys on its own.

item.title: Your Building Blocks Set the Ceiling on AI-Assisted Delivery
item.description: AI made code generation cheap; it did nothing to reduce the cost of being wrong. Shared packages, explicit contracts, executable rules, and reliable gates now determine how much useful work a team can get from AI-assisted development.

item.title: Designing Systems Before Coding Them
item.description: Many teams still generate API contracts after the implementation. Designing the interface first gives backend, frontend, QA, and service consumers one artifact to review, validate, and build against before integration problems become expensive.
